sources.title: Spin-2 spectrum of defect theories

evidence.text: Linearize the Einstein equations for factorized four-dimensional transverse-traceless perturbations, Weyl-rescale the background to direct-product form, and eliminate matter-source dependence using the background Einstein equations. Maximal symmetry permits setting other field perturbations to zero at this order.

sources.title: Cobordism Conjecture in AdS

evidence.text: Introduce anomaly-canceling junction degrees of freedom, bend a CFT toward the bulk to supply brane degrees of freedom, and apply the folding trick to obtain walls from boundaries. Double Wick rotation relates wall configurations to evolution between the two AdS descriptions.

sources.title: Spin-2 spectrum of defect theories

evidence.text: Expand on the two spheres in spherical harmonics and formulate the remaining weighted spectral problem on the strip. In the undeformed AdS5×S5 case, separation and t=tanh x reduce the equation to associated Legendre functions; endpoint normalizability selects the known spectrum.

sources.title: Spin-2 spectrum of defect theories

evidence.text: For sphere-constant Janus modes, separate strip variables and use t=tanh x followed by s=t². Even and odd sectors reduce to Heun equations. Numerical eigenvalues are found by matching logarithmic derivatives of high-order series about s=0 and s=1 at an intermediate convergence point.

sources.title: Cobordism Conjecture in AdS

evidence.text: Use Virasoro interface gluing and its central extension to derive the two-dimensional gravitational-anomaly matching condition. The preserved combination involves both CFTs' left- and right-moving generators for every integer mode.

sources.title: Cobordism Conjecture in AdS

evidence.text: Define interpolation through local observable algebras in domains of dependence and their approximate descriptions in entanglement wedges. For an existing conformal interface, short-distance correlators far from the interface motivate the required local approximation.

sources.title: Aspects of dynamical cobordism in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How do known microscopic AdS5 end-of-the-world configurations realize dynamical cobordism in five dimensions, complete Karch–Randall branes with localized gravity, and extend to holographic theories with reduced supersymmetry?
